description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerSpecifications" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RequirementsRussianTeam" name="Vodka bar requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RequirementsIrishTeam" name="Whiskey bar requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsRussianTeam" name="Vodka bar parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsIrishTeam" name="Whiskey bar parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AirplaneDelivered" name="Airplane delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_AirplaneManufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PartnerTeams" name="Partner Manufacturing Teams"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Specifications" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSpecifications" targetRef="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsRussianTeam" name="Vodka bar requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam" targetRef="Participant_PartnerTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsIrishTeam" name="Whiskey bar requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam" targetRef="Participant_PartnerTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsRussianTeam" name="Vodka bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_PartnerTeams" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RussianPartsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsIrishTeam" name="Whiskey bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_PartnerTeams" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_IrishPartsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocolToCustomer" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_TestProtocolReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AirplaneDelivered" name="Airplane delivered" sourceRef="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AirplaneDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="UserTask_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmationReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerOrder" name="Customer starts airplane order"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ChooseBars" name="Choose interior bars (five available)"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ChooseSeats" name="Choose number of seats"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ChooseColor" name="Choose color"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ChooseToiletWater" name="Choose amount of water in toilets"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to manufacturer" messageRef="Message_CustomerSpecifications"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_TestProtocolReceived" name="Test protocol received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_TestProtocolReceived" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_AirplaneDelivered" name="Airplane delivered to customer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AirplaneDelivered" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm delivery"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerDone" name="Delivery confirmed by customer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerOrder" targetRef="UserTask_ChooseBars"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C2" sourceRef="UserTask_ChooseBars" targetRef="UserTask_ChooseSeats"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C3" sourceRef="UserTask_ChooseSeats" targetRef="UserTask_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C4" sourceRef="UserTask_ChooseColor" targetRef="UserTask_ChooseToiletWater"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C5" sourceRef="UserTask_ChooseToiletWater" targetRef="SendTask_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C6" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSpecifications" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_TestProtocolReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C7" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_TestProtocolReceived" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AirplaneDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C8" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AirplaneDelivered" targetRef="UserTask_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_C9" sourceRef="UserTask_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_AirplaneManufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived" name="Customer specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_CustomerSpecifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam" name="Send vodka bar requirements to Russian team" messageRef="Message_RequirementsRussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam" name="Send whiskey bar requirements to Irish team" messageRef="Message_RequirementsIrishTeam"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_RussianPartsReceived" name="Vodka bar parts received from Russian team">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RussianParts" messageRef="Message_PartsRussianTeam"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_IrishPartsReceived" name="Whiskey bar parts received from Irish team">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_IrishParts" messageRef="Message_PartsIrishTeam"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble plane interior"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestSplit" name="Start test flight and protocol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductTestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="Flight and protocol completed"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTestProtocolToCustomer" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmationReceived" name="Customer delivery confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M2" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RussianPartsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RussianPartsReceived" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_IrishPartsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M5" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_IrishPartsReceived" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M6" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_TestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M7" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductTestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M8" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M9" sourceRef="Task_ConductTestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M10" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M11" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocolToCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M12" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocolToCustomer" targetRef="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M13" sourceRef="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_M14" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmationReceived" targetRef="EndEvent_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
